exposure: gestational age at birth (referred to as pregnancy cycle)
outcome: 28-day mortality in children with severe pneumonia
cohort: The study included 155 children with severe pneumonia who received fiberoptic bronchoscopic bronchoalveolar lavage.
finding: Age, pneumonia course, gestational age at birth (pregnancy cycle), white blood cell count (WBC), procalcitonin (PCT), and systemic immune-inflammation index (SII) were identified as independent predictors of 28-day mortality in children with severe pneumonia after fiberoptic bronchoscopic bronchoalveolar lavage, with pneumonia course, PCT, and SII showing higher predictive efficacy.
gest_age: Not specified as an inclusion criterion; gestational age at birth (pregnancy cycle) was a measured exposure.
